verdict.rationale: Bugbot is a SaaS code-review service, so registrable outbound webhooks are a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence only shows Bugbot reacting to PR events and posting findings as PR comments. Nothing documents outbound HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer can register to receive. PR comments, Bugbot Automations rules, and a user's GitHub Action trigger are adjacent features or workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
